__NOTOC__{{recipesummary|category=Colombian recipes|servings=6|time=Cook 1 hour|difficulty=4|Image=[[Image:Pastel_Arroz.jpg|300px]]}}{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Colombia|Cuisine of Colombia]]

El '''Pastel de Arroz''' (rice tamale) is typical dish from Cartagena, [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Colombia|Colombia]]. It is very common to find it on Sundays at the beach or as a Christmas Eve favourite.
==Ingredients==

=== Rice ===
* 1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* ½ cup white [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Annatto|onoto]] seeds
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Corn Oil|corn oil]] or [[Cookbook:Sunflower Oil|sunflower oil]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]

=== Filling ===
* 6 chunks of tender [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]]
* 6 pieces of [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] (drumsticks or cutlets recommended)
* 6 small [[w:Vienna sausage|Vienna sausages]]
* 6 small [[Cookbook:Chorizo|chorizos]]
* 6 slices of [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]]
* Assorted [[Cookbook:Pickle|pickles]] ([[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]], [[Cookbook:Green Bean|green beans]], [[Cookbook:Cauliflower|cauliflower]], [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|red pepper]], [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]])
* 1 can (16 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) Goya [[Cookbook:Chickpea|chickpeas]]
* 3 medium [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]]
* 3 red [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* 12 large [[Cookbook:Cabbage|cabbage]] leaves
* 24 large "lobster claw" leaves (can be replaced with [[Cookbook:Banana|banana]] plant leaves)
* [[Cookbook:Caper|Capers]], [[Cookbook:Olive|olives]], and pickled [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]]

==Procedure==

=== Rice ===
# Mix all the ingredients well in a large [[Cookbook:Pyrex|Pyrex]] [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]].
# Let stand one day under the sun (this is called ''orear'').

=== Assembly ===
# Place 1 leaf of cabbage on top of a clean working area.
# Spread ⅛ cup of the rice mixture over the cabbage leaf.
# Place one unit of each meat evenly through the pastel.
# Place pickles, chickpeas, capers, pickled onions on top of the meats.
# Place 2 slices of potato and 2 slices of tomato on top. Cover with another ⅛ cup of rice mixture.
# Cover with one leaf of cabbage.
# Place one washed lobster claw / banana leaf in a plain working area. Carefully put the pastel over the leaf and roll firmly. Cover with a second leaf and roll firmly. Tie with thread.
# Cook in a large pan, covered with water, vinegar and salt, for 2 hours.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* Onoto substitutes: pinch of [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]] (for color not flavor); an equal amount of [[Cookbook:Saffron|saffron]]; yellow food coloring; hot paprika; or equal parts turmeric and paprika.
* You can prepare your own pickles: For 6 pastels boil 1½ cup water, ½ cup vinegar, 4 tbsp brown sugar and 1 large carrot cut into 6 sticks, 2 celery sticks cut in three pieces each, 6 green beans cut in half, 1 large red bell pepper cut into 12 sticks, and 1 small cauliflower. Let cool down and keep refrigerated overnight, before using it.
